notes.title: Update № 1
notes.content:
In this update, [b]the mechanics of the cube movement[/b] were changed for more convenient control, as well as minor bugs were fixed.

Dear players! Thank you very much for your feedback! Have a nice game!

[u][b]We are also glad to announce that the game is currently with a 40% discount! Hurry up![/b][/u]
